description.en: Moulded-case breaker for feeders and mains, with adjustable or fixed trip units, rated current from 16 A to 1600 A.
description.es: Interruptor de caja moldeada para alimentadores y acometidas, con unidad de disparo fija o regulable, de 16 A a 1600 A.

sources.title: Standard breaker sizes: MCCB current ratings 16 A to 1600 A

note.en: Industrial circuit breaker standard (cited, not quoted)
note.es: Norma de interruptores industriales (citada, no transcrita)

note.en: IEC 60617 public page lists no identifiers for this item; not found, not guessed.
note.es: La pagina publica de IEC 60617 no lista identificadores para este elemento; no encontrado, no supuesto.
Corrientes nominales estandar de 16 a 1600 A

note.en: Range by frame: small 25-50 kA, medium 35-70 kA, large 50-100 kA; the same page also lists 65-150 kA for large frames (conflict, check catalogue)
note.es: Rango por tamano: pequeno 25-50 kA, medio 35-70 kA, grande 50-100 kA; la misma pagina lista 65-150 kA para grande (conflicto, verificar catalogo)

note.en: Ics expressed as a percentage of Icu
note.es: Ics expresado como porcentaje de Icu

when_to_use.en: Feeders and mains where the prospective short-circuit current or the current exceeds MCB limits (rated current above 125 A)
when_to_use.es: Alimentadores y acometidas donde la corriente o la corriente de cortocircuito superan los limites del MCB (nominal superior a 125 A)

when_to_use.en: Selectable trip unit (thermal and magnetic, electronic) for selectivity studies (typical)
when_to_use.es: Unidad de disparo regulable (termomagnetica o electronica) para estudios de selectividad (typical)

when_not_to_use.en: Continuous current above 1600 A: use ACB
when_not_to_use.es: Corriente continua superior a 1600 A: usar ACB

when_not_to_use.en: Small final circuit where an MCB is sufficient: MCB is lower cost (typical)
when_not_to_use.es: Circuito final pequeno donde basta un MCB: el MCB es de menor coste (typical)
